name: The Adventurer
summary: Near Deathknell, The Adventurer is sent to investigate a stranger by the road to Brill. Scarlet Crusaders threaten the region, but the stranger is Eleanor Shackleton, a Forsaken traveler with wilderness skills to share.

sections.title: A Suspicious Watch
sections.body: Executor Arren watches Deathknell and the roads around it. Scarlet Crusaders spy on the region and infiltrate northern Lordaeron, so an unfamiliar figure near Brill draws suspicion. You have proved your dedication by striking at Crusader threats along the border. Now Arren asks you to investigate the stranger quietly and learn whether she threatens the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Traveler in the Woods
sections.body: You find Eleanor Shackleton by the roadside near Brill. She is a Forsaken traveler, pausing before another journey into the wilds, with no Crusader plot or Scourge necromancy in mind. Eleanor sees a fellow adventurer in those sent to check on her. She offers to teach you how to survive in open country and make camp.

faq.q: Why does Executor Arren want Eleanor investigated?
faq.answer: Scarlet Crusade infiltrators and hostile spies threaten Deathknell and Brill. Arren treats anyone unfamiliar on the high road with suspicion until their purpose is clear.
Eleanor Shackleton is a Forsaken adventurer camping by the road near Brill. She explores the wilderness and offers fellow travelers practical survival skills.

faq.q: Is Eleanor connected to the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: No. Eleanor has no ties to the Scarlet Crusade, whose zealots threaten Tirisfal Glades.
Speaking with Eleanor leads to The Great Outdoors, where she begins teaching you wilderness survival and how to make camp.

faq.q: Where can Eleanor Shackleton be found?
faq.answer: Eleanor camps just off the main road east toward Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why did Executor Arren choose you for this mission?
faq.answer: You earned Arren's trust by rooting out Scarlet Crusade agents and messengers near Deathknell. That work showed you could handle sensitive reconnaissance.

angles.text: For a new Forsaken near Deathknell, meeting Eleanor, a fellow adventurer, shows that a stranger near Brill may be no Scarlet spy.
As a member of the Horde, you can gain practical survival skills by speaking with wandering travelers while Executor Arren guards the Forsaken realm's young borders.
